name: kcd-connect
title: KCD Connect
description: Control your paired phones and tablets from the launcher, over the kcd daemon socket
author: dagimg-dot

commands.name: devices
commands.title: Devices
commands.description: Live overview of every paired device, with battery, signal and all actions

commands.name: send-file
commands.title: Send File
commands.description: Pick files and send them to a device, with live transfer progress

commands.name: send-clipboard
commands.title: Send Clipboard
commands.description: Push the current clipboard contents to a device

commands.name: ring-device
commands.title: Ring Device
commands.description: Make a device play a loud ringtone so you can find it

commands.name: send-sms
commands.title: Send SMS
commands.description: Compose and send a text message through your phone

commands.name: media-control
commands.title: Media Control
commands.description: Control media playing on your paired devices

commands.name: pair-device
commands.title: Pair Device
commands.description: Discover nearby devices and pair them with this computer

preferences.name: socketPath
preferences.title: Socket Path
preferences.description: Override the kcd IPC socket path. Leave empty to use $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/kcd/kcd.sock
